detail.instructions: Lead with the cashflow risk: rejected subsidy claims stall payment and create avoidable rework for EPC teams managing retrofit programmes. Frame the platform as a pre-submission safety net that checks dossiers, cross-validates evidence, and flags missing proofs across multi-site grant paperwork so claims go in clean the first time.
detail.followup_instructions: Follow up by sharpening the operational angle: every rejected dossier means another cycle of admin, corrections, and delayed release of funds. Push the idea that the platform helps EPC firms standardize validation across projects and countries, reducing submission errors before they hit the authority and protecting project cashflow.
